metadata.description: gs-claude-config as one-click Claude Code plugins: a hook-free toolkit of 42 skills, 20 slash commands, and 5 subagents, plus two optional hook plugins (autopilot, meta-harness) you install separately.

plugins.name: gs-claude-toolkit
plugins.description: 42 skills (safe-yolo, survey-first, repo-scan, daily-summary, git-tag, quant-researcher, blender-physics-lint, and 35 more), 20 slash commands, and 5 subagents. Ships ZERO hooks — fully passive, nothing fires on your sessions.

plugins.name: gs-autopilot
plugins.description: Optional Stop-hook that powers the /autopilot skill (keep working until done / ceiling). Install ONLY if you want autopilot — it registers a Stop hook that runs every turn-end. Cross-platform Node shim, no jq.

plugins.name: gs-meta-harness
plugins.description: Optional safety + context hooks from the gs-harness meta-loop. branch-guard: a PreToolUse hard gate blocking pushes to main/master, force pushes, --mirror and protected-branch deletion on BOTH the Bash and PowerShell tools, still enforced under bypassPermissions where deny rules are skipped; needs no external dependency, live the moment you install it. context-inject: a SessionStart hook injecting the cross-repo context gs-harness pre-renders — needs gs-harness on the machine, and without it the hook silently prints nothing and exits 0. Install ONLY if you want these hooks; the base gs-claude-toolkit plugin stays hook-free. Cross-platform Node, no jq, no pwsh.
